create_prolific_study: create a new Prolific study by posting study data to the Prolific API
list_prolific_studies: list all Prolific studies by fetching from the studies API endpoint
retrieve_prolific_study: retrieve a single Prolific study by its ID from the API
update_prolific_study: update an existing Prolific study by its ID with new data via PATCH
calculate_prolific_study_cost: calculate the total cost of a Prolific study given reward and available places
